scenarios.scenario: Deep — Full autonomous root cause investigation and fix proposal

rubricScores.criterion: Found the MSB3073 error in the DataSources project's signing step and identified the specific file(s) that failed
Traced the failing file to its origin — placed in shared folder by a different project
Discovered multiple projects set Distrib to same ConfigurationLinterService path
Identified CAS read-only hard links as cause
Proposed removing Distrib/Robocopy from library projects so service project owns folder
Verified fix would result in each project signing only its own files

scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, evidence-dense investigation with node IDs and file/line citations throughout; recovered instantly from path-format tool errors. Root cause, ownership trace, cross-project property pattern, and non-determinism are all correct and well supported. Minor weaknesses: the recommended primary fix slightly misassigns which project should surrender Distrib, and there is no explicit verification step for the proposed fix.
